referents.why: 'their secret arts' belongs to the magicians, who are the doers of cl0; masculine plural agrees.
'they were not able' is third common plural, the same doers as cl0, the magicians.
referents.category: implied subject of a failed attempt

links.why: lamed + infinitive construct saying what the act was done to achieve: to bring forth the gnats.
the attempt, with a purpose, followed by 'and' + a negated verb of ability is the attempt's failed_result, which replaces the plain and.
an attempt with a purpose, then 'and' + a negated verb of being able: the attempt's outcome failed.
wayyiqtol continuing the narrative line after the failure.
this verse has only cl0 to cl3; cl4 is a clause of an earlier verse, and a then-link across verses is not a link type here.
'did thus' (ken) with a named subject, the magicians, who were not commanded: imitation of the deed just done after the latest command, the striking of the dust (not fulfilment).
